100 * (
  1 - (
    (
      (sum(rate(cadence_errors{deployment=~"$deployment", cadence_service=~"cadence-matching|cadence_matching"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
      +
      (sum(rate(cadence_errors_rollup{deployment=~"$deployment", cadence_service=~"cadence-matching|cadence_matching"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
    )
    /
    (
      (sum(rate(cadence_requests{deployment=~"$deployment", cadence_service=~"cadence-matching|cadence_matching"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
      +
      (sum(rate(cadence_requests_rollup{deployment=~"$deployment", cadence_service=~"cadence-matching|cadence_matching"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))
    )
  )
)
